sloka: निहत्य तां राक्षसवाहिनीं तु रामस्तदा शक्रसमो महात्मा।अस्त्रेषु शस्त्रेषु जितक्लमश्च संस्तूयते देवगणैः प्रहृष्टैः ।। ६.९४.३९ ।।
transliteration: nihatya tāṁ rākṣasavāhinīṁ tu rāmastadā śakrasamo mahātmā।astreṣu śastreṣu jitaklamaśca saṁstūyate devagaṇaiḥ prahṛṣṭaiḥ ।। 6.94.39 ।।

translations.english: Having thus destroyed that army of rakshasas, the great-souled Rama, the equal of Indra, unwearied in the use of missiles and weapons, was praised by the rejoicing hosts of gods.
